pin_note: This pin follows the canonical registry source/registry/runtime-versions.json (runtimes.v2.version); it was bumped to the current canonical V2 pin on 2026-10-05 (previously two minor releases behind). CLOSURE 2026-10-06: real-runtime probe collection ran against 2.0.23 (evidence/v3.1/runtime-reliability/session-lane-2026-10-06/v2-native-probes.json); session-permission-narrowing observed NOT enforced on the /shell surface (fail-open observed there) and the other probes stayed ambiguous without model inference or operator-owned policy config. NO exact-binary-live record exists, so all 8 features remain hold-unproven WITH real collection evidence; runtime_grant_enforcement.v2 stays OFF (sustained HOLD, program-status.json#closure_2026_10_06). Collection plus validation is operator-owned by design (see evidence_contract.writer_contract).
activation_rule: A candidate is enabled only by a valid exact-binary-live evidence record; a declaration in this file is never an enabler (plan 17.10: do not enable a feature if exact-binary behavior is not proven).

evidence_contract.hash_input_note: record_hash is the sha256 of the compact canonical JSON object built from hashed_fields in the declared order, with verified_at normalized to UTC round-trip form; writers must use Get-OrchestrationV2NativeEvidenceHash so both sides agree.
evidence_contract.writer_contract: The gating library is read-only and never writes evidence; the validation slice (operator / P42) appends records after proving exact-binary behavior.

session-hierarchy-provenance.description: Native root/family/parent session provenance reported by the V2 runtime (plan 17.2).

session-permission-narrowing.description: Session-specific permissions rendered from the Dispatch Contract narrowing only; child authority never exceeds the Planner/Task grant (plan 17.3).

experimental-policies-hard-deny.description: experimental.policies hard-deny invariants where the exact API proves deny wins over an ordinary allow; authority only tightens (plan 17.4).

native-step-limits.description: Native step limits derived from the canonical execution budgets instead of a duplicated local counter (plan 17.5).

background-subagents-bounded.description: Background subagents with bounded concurrency while the kernel/reconciler keeps owning restart reconciliation (plan 17.6).

plugin-storage-index.description: Plugin storage used as a rebuildable runtime-only index, never as authoritative state (plan 17.7).

snapshots-auxiliary.description: Snapshots as auxiliary evidence/recovery material that never overrides Git or worktree state (plan 17.8).

durable-event-log-replay.description: Durable session event log used as experimental secondary replay only; its absence never breaks task recovery (plan 17.9).
